title: Bloody Swords CIT
description: a CIT pack that lets you make your swords bloody :^)
body:
###
REQUIRES OPTIFINE!
(unless something like CIT resewn for 1.12.2 exists)

put "bloody" in front of any sword's name and it'll become bloody :^)

the bloody part might (will, actually) be vertically flipped when you hold it
